events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, collections
s='S5'
counts=collections.Counter(); ov=collections.Counter()
for line in open(f'set_{s}.bed'):
    c=line.split()[0]; counts[c]+=1
res=subprocess.check_output(f'bedtools intersect -wao -a set_{s}.bed -b dhs_index_sorted.bed',shell=True).decode().splitlines()
# -wao reports each a with overlap b count >0? Sum duplicates problematic. use -u per chrom
for line in open(f'set_{s}.bed'):
    c=line.split()[0]; counts[c]+=1
# better per chrom -u
for c in sorted(counts):
    p=subprocess.run(f\"awk '"'$1=='"\\\"{c}\\\"' set_{s}.bed | bedtools intersect -u -a stdin -b dhs_index_sorted.bed | wc -l\",shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    ov[c]=int(p.stdout.strip())
for c in sorted(counts):
    print(c, counts[c], ov[c], round(ov[c]/counts[c],3))
PY"
